airspace.zh: 越南規定，國內外的組織與個人操作無人機，都須事先向越南國防部（越南人民軍總參謀部作戰局）申請飛行許可，申請至少要在預定飛行日的七個工作天前提出；禁飛與限飛區由國防部公告，主要包括機場與國防安全區域。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: In Viet Nam, domestic and foreign organisations and individuals need a flight permit from the Ministry of National Defence (Department of Operations, General Staff of the People's Army) before flying a drone, applied for at least seven working days ahead; no-fly and restricted zones, mainly airports and defence areas, are published by the ministry. Check the current rules before any real flight.

title.en: From the Bạch Đằng River to World Heritage

tagline.zh-Hant: 擋住外敵的水道、1962年的太空人，與三次登錄
tagline.en: Channels that stopped invaders, a cosmonaut in 1962, and three listings

zh: 「下龍」的意思，是「降落的龍」。
不過這個名字，十九世紀以前的古書裡並沒有記載。
en: Hạ Long means "descending dragon".
Yet the name does not appear in books written before the 19th century.

zh: 更早的時候，這片海灣曾叫安邦、綠水或雲屯。
名字換了，海上的石林一直都在。
en: Earlier names included An Bang, Lục Thủy and Vân Đồn.
The names changed; the stone forest stayed.

zh: 西邊的白藤江，在越南歷史上很有名。
越南軍隊曾三次在這裡的水道擋下北方的入侵者。
en: To the west, the Bạch Đằng River holds a famous place in Vietnamese history.
Three times Vietnamese forces stopped invaders from the north in its channels.

zh: 1288年，陳興道在江中插下包鐵的木樁。
退潮時，忽必烈的船隊撞上木樁，紛紛沉沒。
en: In 1288, Trần Hưng Đạo planted iron-tipped wooden stakes in the river.
As the tide fell, Kublai Khan's fleet was impaled and sank.

zh: 石灰岩島之間曲折的水道，
對熟悉地形的人來說，就是天然的防線。
en: The winding channels between limestone islands
were a natural defence line for those who knew them.

zh: 十九世紀末，法國訪客把木頭洞稱為「奇觀之洞」。
這個洞位在海灣北部的Dấu Gỗ島上。
en: In the late 19th century, French visitors named Đầu Gỗ the Grotte des Merveilles.
The cave lies on Dấu Gỗ Island in the north of the bay.

zh: 1948年，法國與越南方面在下龍灣簽下《下龍灣協定》。
這片海灣，也見證了二十世紀的政治變局。
en: In 1948 the Halong Bay Agreements were signed here between France and Vietnamese leaders.
The bay also witnessed the political upheavals of the 20th century.

zh: 1962年1月22日，胡志明陪同蘇聯太空人季托夫來到這座島。
胡志明隨後把島改名為「蒂托普島」，也就是季托夫島。
en: On 22 January 1962 Hồ Chí Minh brought Soviet cosmonaut Gherman Titov to this island.
He then renamed it Ti Tốp, Titov Island.

zh: 島上原本埋葬著1905年一艘法國貨船沉沒時的罹難水手。
2015年，島上立起了季托夫的紀念像。
en: Sailors lost when a French cargo ship sank nearby in 1905 were buried here.
In 2015 a monument to Titov was raised on the island.

zh: 1994年，下龍灣以壯麗的景觀列入世界遺產。
2000年，它的地質價值也獲得肯定。
en: In 1994 Ha Long Bay was inscribed as a World Heritage site for its scenery.
In 2000 its geological value was recognised too.

zh: 2023年9月16日，遺產範圍擴大到吉婆群島。
它成為越南第一處跨越兩個省市的世界自然遺產。
en: On 16 September 2023 the site was extended to the Cát Bà archipelago.
It became Vietnam's first World Natural Heritage site spanning two provinces.

zh: 吉婆島屬於海防市，下龍灣屬於廣寧省。
名稱也改成「下龍灣－吉婆群島」。
en: Cát Bà belongs to Hải Phòng; Ha Long Bay to Quảng Ninh province.
The site is now called Ha Long Bay – Cát Bà Archipelago.

zh: 北岸的拜齋橋，連接下龍市的兩岸。
城市就建在遺產區的邊緣。
en: On the north shore, the Bãi Cháy Bridge joins the two halves of Ha Long city.
The city stands right at the edge of the heritage area.

zh: 今天，遺產區內有一千多艘遊船在營運。
觀光帶來收入，也帶來汙染的壓力。
en: Today more than 1,000 tour boats operate inside the property.
Tourism brings income, and the pressure of pollution.

zh: 從抵禦外敵的水道，到世界各地旅客的航線，
同一片石林，承載了不同時代的故事。
en: From channels that stopped invaders to routes for travellers from everywhere,
the same stone forest has carried the stories of every age.

tagline.zh-Hant: 龍的傳說、漂浮漁村，與每天穿梭的遊船
tagline.en: A dragon legend, floating villages and the boats of today

zh: 傳說，天上的龍族降到這裡，吐出一顆顆寶珠。
寶珠落進海裡，變成島嶼，築成抵禦外敵的城牆。
en: Legend says a family of dragons came down here and spat out jewels.
The jewels became islands, a wall against invaders.

zh: 「下龍」這個名字，就來自這個故事。
在越南，龍象徵著守護。
en: The name Hạ Long, "descending dragon", comes from that story.
In Vietnam the dragon stands for protection.

zh: 傳說中，母龍降落在下龍，小龍們降落在東邊的拜子龍灣。
龍族吐出的寶珠，散落成今天的群島。
en: In the legend the mother dragon landed at Hạ Long, her young at Bái Tử Long Bay to the east.
The dragons' jewels scattered into today's islands.

zh: 許多島依形狀命名。
兩塊相對而立的石頭，被叫作「鬥雞石」。
en: Many islands are named for their shapes.
Two rocks facing each other are called the Fighting Cocks.

zh: 過去，海灣裡有四座漂浮漁村：
昆芽、巴航、共濤和翁榮，住著約一千六百人。
en: The bay once held four floating fishing villages:
Cửa Vạn, Ba Hang, Cống Tàu and Vông Viêng, home to about 1,600 people.

zh: 漁民住在浮在水上的木屋裡，在島嶼間的避風水域捕魚。
石灰岩島圍出的海灣，擋住了大浪。
en: Fishing families lived in houses floating on the water, fishing the sheltered channels.
The limestone islands kept out the big waves.

zh: 2014年5月起，三百多戶水上人家遷到岸上的安置區。
理由之一，是減少海灣的汙染。
en: From May 2014, more than 300 floating households were moved to a resettlement area on land.
One reason was to cut pollution in the bay.

zh: 部分舊漁村保留下來，成為觀光景點。
遊客可以坐手划小船，進入島嶼之間。
en: Some of the old villages remain, as places for visitors.
Row boats take visitors in among the islands.

zh: 吉婆群島的蓋貝奧遺址，被認為是越南最古老的漁村。
人們在這片海上生活，已有數千年。
en: Cái Bèo on the Cát Bà archipelago is described as Vietnam's oldest fishing village.
People have lived from this sea for thousands of years.

zh: 蒂托普島的名字，紀念1962年來訪的蘇聯太空人季托夫。
一座島的名字，記下了一段外交往來。
en: Ti Tốp is named after Gherman Titov, the Soviet cosmonaut who visited in 1962.
An island's name preserves a moment of diplomacy.

zh: 蒂托普島是遊船最常停靠的島之一。
遊客上岸游泳，或爬上山頂眺望整片海灣。
en: Ti Tốp is one of the islands where cruise boats most often stop.
Visitors swim, or climb to the top for a view across the bay.

zh: 對面博杭島上的驚訝洞，是遊船行程的另一站。
洞裡的鐘乳石，被人們比喻成各種動物與人物。
en: Opposite, the Surprise Cave on Bồ Hòn is another stop on the boat routes.
Visitors read animals and figures into its stalactites.

zh: 2015年，《紐約時報》把搭水上飛機看下龍灣，
列為當年最吸引人的旅遊體驗之一。
en: In 2015 The New York Times listed seeing the bay from a seaplane
among that year's most attractive travel experiences.

zh: 今天，遺產區內有一千多艘遊船。
觀光是當地最重要的收入來源之一。
en: Today more than 1,000 tour boats work inside the property.
Tourism is one of the main sources of local income.

zh: 北岸的下龍市，靠近煤礦與工業區。
越南計畫在2030年前結束遺產區附近的工業活動。
en: Ha Long city on the north shore sits near coal mines and industry.
Vietnam plans to end industrial activity around the site by 2030.

zh: 南邊的蘭下灣，島嶼同樣密布。
這裡的遊船，多從吉婆島出發。
en: To the south, Lan Hạ Bay is just as crowded with islands.
Boats here mostly set out from Cát Bà.

zh: 從龍的傳說、水上人家，到滿載遊客的船，
人們一直以不同的方式，住在這片石林之間。
en: From a dragon legend to floating homes and boats full of visitors,
people have always found ways to live among these stone towers.

tagline.zh-Hant: 金頭葉猴、海水湖、紅樹林，與上千種魚
tagline.en: Golden-headed langurs, marine lakes, mangroves and a thousand kinds of fish

zh: 吉婆島的石灰岩峭壁上，住著吉婆葉猴。
牠是只住在這座島上的特有種。
en: The limestone cliffs of Cát Bà are home to the Cát Bà langur.
It lives on this island and nowhere else.

zh: 牠的身體是深褐色，頭和肩膀卻是亮金色。
剛出生的小猴，全身是金橘色。
en: Its body is dark brown, its head and shoulders bright gold.
Newborns are golden orange all over.

zh: 吉婆葉猴是極度瀕危物種，全世界不到七十隻。
2003年時，一度只剩約四十隻。
en: The langur is critically endangered, with fewer than 70 left in the world.
In 2003 only about 40 remained.

zh: 1986年，牠的棲地劃為國家公園。
2006年擴大保護範圍，涵蓋全部族群。
en: In 1986 the langur's range was declared a national park.
In 2006 protection was widened to cover the whole population.

zh: 2000年11月，德國明斯特動物園等單位展開吉婆葉猴保育計畫。
2001年底，獵捕葉猴的行為停止了。
en: In November 2000, Münster Zoo and partners began the Cát Bà Langur Conservation Project.
By the end of 2001, hunting of the langurs had stopped.

zh: 這片海與島，包含七種相鄰的熱帶、亞熱帶海島生態系。
從珊瑚、海草到石灰岩森林，一層接著一層。
en: Sea and islands here combine seven adjoining tropical and subtropical marine-island ecosystems,
from corals and seagrass to limestone forest.

zh: 擴大後的遺產區，擁有全世界約三分之一的海水湖。
這些湖藏在石灰岩島中間，透過岩縫與海相通。
en: The extended site holds about a third of the world's marine lakes.
Hidden inside limestone islands, they connect to the sea through the rock.

zh: 從空中看，海水湖像嵌在島裡的一塊塊碧玉。
湖裡的生物，和外海的又不太一樣。
en: From above, the marine lakes look like pieces of jade set into the islands.
Their life differs from that of the open sea.

zh: 這片海域記錄了約一千種魚。
還有下龍棕櫚等只長在這裡的植物。
en: About 1,000 species of fish have been recorded in these waters,
along with plants such as the Ha Long palm found nowhere else.

zh: 島上的植物，要扎根在近乎垂直的石灰岩上。
岩縫裡的一點土壤，就是它們的家。
en: Plants on the islands must root on near-vertical limestone.
A little soil in a crack is home enough.

zh: 海灣西側的河口，有紅樹林沿岸生長。
紅樹林是魚蝦的育幼場，也能擋住海浪。
en: Along the estuaries on the west, mangroves line the shore.
They are nurseries for fish and shrimp, and a buffer against waves.

zh: 填海造地，讓紅樹林的面積逐漸縮小。
這是遺產區面臨的威脅之一。
en: Land reclamation has been shrinking the mangroves.
It is one of the threats facing the site.

zh: 島上的洞穴裡，也有特有的生物。
2023年，科學家在海底洞穴發現了一種新的海綿。
en: The caves have their own life as well.
In 2023 scientists found a new species of sponge in an underwater cave here.

zh: 吉婆島上還有吉婆虎紋守宮，和鋸緣閉殼龜等受威脅物種。
石灰岩森林，是牠們最後的家。
en: Cát Bà also shelters threatened species such as the Cát Bà tiger gecko and the keeled box turtle.
Its limestone forest is their last home.

zh: 遺產區內還有42處沼澤濕地。
淡水從河口流進來，與海水交會。
en: The area also contains 42 marshes.
At the river mouths fresh water meets the sea.

zh: 過度捕撈與非法採集，也威脅著海裡的生物。
保護海灣，不只是保護風景。
en: Overfishing and illegal harvesting also threaten life in the sea.
Protecting the bay means more than protecting a view.

zh: 遊船、汙水與廢棄物，正考驗著這片海域。
附近的煤礦和水泥廠，也會排放汙染。
en: Boats, wastewater and rubbish are testing these waters.
Coal mines and a cement works nearby add their own pollution.

zh: 峭壁上的金頭葉猴、島中的海水湖、河口的紅樹林，
這片石林不只是風景，也是許多生命唯一的家。
en: Golden-headed langurs on the cliffs, lakes inside islands, mangroves at the river mouths:
this stone forest is not just scenery but the only home of many lives.

title.en: A Stone Forest in the Sea

tagline.zh-Hant: 近兩千座石灰岩島，與兩千萬年的喀斯特演化
tagline.en: Nearly 2,000 limestone islets and 20 million years of karst

zh: 越南北部的下龍灣，面積約一千五百五十三平方公里。
海面上散布著約一千九百多座小島。
en: Ha Long Bay in northern Vietnam covers about 1,553 square kilometres.
Some 1,969 islets are scattered across it.

zh: 這些島幾乎都是石灰岩。
其中989座有自己的名字。
en: Almost all of them are limestone.
989 of them have names of their own.

zh: 大多數小島是高五十到一百公尺的石柱。
最高的超過兩百公尺。
en: Most are towers 50 to 100 metres high.
The tallest exceed 200 metres.

zh: 形成這些石灰岩的沉積，經歷了約五億年。
溶蝕成今天的喀斯特地形，又花了約兩千萬年。
en: The limestone itself built up over some 500 million years.
Dissolving it into this karst took about 20 million more.

zh: 喀斯特分兩種：連在一起的峰叢，和各自獨立的峰林。
下龍灣的石柱，是典型的峰林。
en: Karst comes in two kinds: clustered cones, fengcong, and lone towers, fenglin.
Ha Long's pillars are classic fenglin.

zh: 仔細看石壁底部，有一道向內凹的「海蝕凹壁」。
海浪和溶蝕在崖腳切出凹槽，深了就成為洞穴。
en: Look at the foot of the cliffs: a notch cut inwards.
Waves and dissolution carve these notches, which can deepen into caves.

zh: 博杭島上的驚訝洞，有寬大的洞廳與鐘乳石。
遺產區內一共記錄了66個洞穴。
en: Sửng Sốt, the Surprise Cave on Bồ Hòn Island, has huge chambers and stalactites.
The heritage area holds 66 recorded caves.

zh: 北邊的木頭洞，有三個洞廳，是這一帶最大的洞穴。
附近的天宮洞，主洞廳長一百多公尺。
en: In the north, Đầu Gỗ cave, with three chambers, is the largest grotto here.
Nearby Thiên Cung cave has a chamber more than 100 metres long.

zh: 有些島的中間，圍著一座封閉的海水湖。
那是被海水淹沒的石灰岩窪地。
en: Some islands enclose a lake of sea water in their middle.
These are limestone hollows, dolines, flooded by the sea.

zh: 洞穴大約形成於兩百萬年到一萬一千年前。
當時海面比現在低，這裡曾是陸地上的石灰岩山地。
en: The caves formed between about two million and 11,000 years ago.
With sea levels lower, this was then dry limestone upland.

zh: 海水漫進來之後，山頭變成了島。
這就是「被海水淹沒的塔狀喀斯特」。
en: When the sea flooded in, the hilltops became islands.
This is what geologists call marine-invaded tower karst.

zh: 南邊的吉婆島，是群島中最大的島。
2023年，吉婆群島併入世界遺產，增加了三百六十多座島。
en: To the south, Cát Bà is the largest island of the archipelago.
In 2023 the Cát Bà archipelago and its 360-plus islands joined the World Heritage site.

zh: 遺產區內還有81座藏在石灰岩島裡的湖。
以及193處沙灘。
en: The area also holds 81 lakes hidden inside limestone islands,
and 193 sandbanks and beaches.

zh: 蒂托普島只有一側是緩坡，坡下是一片白沙灘。
從空中看，沙灘像一彎新月。
en: Ti Tốp has only one gentle side, with a white sand beach below it.
From the air the beach looks like a crescent moon.

zh: 論塔狀喀斯特的規模，這裡僅次於中國陽朔。
而且，這裡的石林泡在海裡。
en: For tower karst, it is said to rank second only to China's Yangshuo.
And here the stone forest stands in the sea.

zh: 五億年的沉積、兩千萬年的溶蝕，加上一次海水上升，
造出了這片海上的石林。
en: Five hundred million years of deposits, 20 million years of dissolving and a rising sea
made this stone forest in the sea.
